lede: Three questions — and you know what you get for hiring. No sign-up.
qWhoN: Must be registered as unemployed with IEM.
qMajN: Blue, green or circular economy; or a gender-imbalanced occupation.
qLvlN: Levels 4 to 8 of the National Qualifications Framework.
qPremN: Employment Premium, if the post is a net addition.
c1: Registered office or branch in Madeira
c2: Clear standing with tax authority and Social Security
c4: The post must be a net addition to headcount
c5: Cannot hire someone who worked for the company in the last 5 years
warn: Note. These schemes only cover people registered as unemployed with IEM in Madeira. Someone arriving from outside the Region does not qualify until registered for the required period.
srcPic: Source: IEM, IP-RAM — Hiring Incentives Programme. Portaria 191/2015, amended by Portaria 913/2024 of 18 December. RMMG-RAM €980.00. Applications open permanently.
srcEp: Source: IEM, IP-RAM — Professional Traineeships in private entities. Portaria 206/2018, amended by Portaria 522/2023. Despacho 110/2026 of 26 February. IAS €537.13.
shareText: The State chips in. Three questions to see what IEM pays when you hire in Madeira:
vLvlN: Levels 6, 7 and 8 of the National Qualifications Framework.
vSalN: Must meet or exceed the minimum required for the level.
vSubFirm: 2 years of salary + 3 years of payroll tax
vShTitle: Two routes for the same hire
vc1: Open-ended, full-time contract, workplace in Madeira
vc2: The candidate must be registered with IEM and tax-resident in the Region
vc3: Base salary at or above the required TRU level
vc4: Training during the support period: 3 months with a tutor or 40 certified hours
vc5: Keep the post and headcount level for 36 months
vc6: Apply before signing the contract; the employee then has 90 days for their own claim
vWarn: They do not stack. For the same job you get PIC or Valorizar C — never both. Support paid to the employee (Valorizar R) is separate and does combine with Valorizar C.
vSrc: Source: IEM, IP-RAM — Valorizar 35 Programme. Portaria 416/2025 of 13 August. RMMG-RAM €980.00; TRU level 16 = €1,499.15, level 26 = €2,028.62. Employer Social Security contribution calculated at 23.75%. Applications until the programme budget is exhausted; de minimis rule applies.
